recommendedNewSections.heading: How to Choose the Best AI Resume Builder
recommendedNewSections.reason: Directly addresses a top PAA question ('Which AI resume builder is best?') and helps users navigate the market, providing objective value beyond promoting a single tool.
recommendedNewSections.suggestedOutline: Key features to look for; Pricing models (free vs. paid); Ease of use and interface; ATS compatibility claims; Customer support and reviews.

recommendedNewSections.heading: Step-by-Step: Creating Your Resume with AI
recommendedNewSections.reason: Provides practical guidance for users new to AI resume builders, improving user experience and demonstrating expertise through a clear process.
recommendedNewSections.suggestedOutline: Choosing your template; Inputting your information; Leveraging AI suggestions; Optimizing for keywords; Reviewing and exporting.

recommendedNewSections.heading: Pros and Cons of Using an AI Resume Builder
recommendedNewSections.reason: Offers a balanced perspective, building trust with the audience by acknowledging both benefits and limitations, which is often overlooked by competitors.
recommendedNewSections.suggestedOutline: Advantages (speed, optimization, templates); Disadvantages (lack of personal touch, potential for generic content, over-reliance); When to use AI vs. human review.
